meta.notes: Tomb: near candles grant upgrade_disk_tomb + 4 dice; far candles reveal Diary Key — both pairs modeled as one ignition event granting all three (simplification: two-step reveal collapsed to one). Diary Key is a REWARD of lighting the Tomb, not a prerequisite. Chapel: lighting the altar grants accumulated Keeper of Tithes coins (chapel_tithes counter, incremented each time the entry -1 coin penalty actually fires); the payout is resolved in engine/special_items.py light(). Trading Post fuse grants (Upgrade Disk + 40 coins) are wiki-documented; the secret room is collapsed to an immediate grant since it is not modeled. Freezer thaw is temporary/daily and not modeled. Mine South ("area": true): lighting the eight candlesticks inside the Abandoned Mine (South) permanently lowers the stairway to the Precipice (engine/game.py::_gate_ctx sets the "candlestick_stairway_lit" flag from state.special.lit_targets, gating both mine_south<->precipice edges in areas.json); it has no grants here because the Upgrade Disk sitting in the mine is a separate, ungated pickup already granted on arrival by engine/special_items.py::on_area_arrival — granting it again here would double-pay. mine_south has no rooms.json record (it is an area-graph node, not a draftable room), so it is the one target keyed by an area id instead of a room id; "area": true marks that. absent_targets lists rooms/areas the wiki mentions that are absent from both rooms.json and this targets table (mine_south graduated out of it once the area graph modeled the node). requires_item is supported by the engine but no target uses it (the Diary Key is a reward of the Tomb, not a prerequisite).
